new_defects.note: CLAUDE.md:364 permits a TRNG-seeded generator for the mask's PWM duty only under conditions that include (b) 'effective internal state ≥ 246 bits' and zeroize on lock. The mask's generator is a 32-bit xorshift whose state is referenced nowhere outside the driver, so it is not zeroized on lock; #805 and #831 discuss condition (d) only, and no issue mentions (b). Not drafted anywhere; it would attach naturally to #831 or #646.
